name: local-verify-refine
description: Verify-refine workflow SIZED FOR LOCAL 7B MODELS (8 GB Mac): generate a small TypeScript function against an explicit checklist, verify it, correct on failure, accept after 2 consecutive passes. Declares an O4 output contract (provides + signature + artefactLanguage) so an accepted run measured with --as-proposal exercises the full execution→intent chain: wfrun_* record → node proposal with workflow_run source → apply --check-providers --strict. Prompts are deliberately short (prefill-bound local models) and the LLM step count is minimal: no self-improvement pass, corrector reads the critique directly.

nodes.prompt:
Write a TypeScript function that converts a title into a URL slug.

Requirements (ALL mandatory):
1. Exactly this export and written signature: export function slugify(title: string): string
2. Lowercase the input.
3. Replace every run of spaces or underscores with a single hyphen.
4. Remove every character that is not a-z, 0-9 or hyphen.
5. Collapse consecutive hyphens into one and trim leading/trailing hyphens.

Output ONLY the TypeScript code. No explanation, no markdown fences, no tests.

TASK CONTEXT:
${INPUT}

You are a strict code reviewer. Check the TypeScript code below against this checklist:
1. It exports exactly: export function slugify(title: string): string
2. It lowercases the input.
3. Runs of spaces/underscores become a single hyphen.
4. Characters outside a-z, 0-9, hyphen are removed.
5. Consecutive hyphens are collapsed and leading/trailing hyphens trimmed.
6. It is plain TypeScript with no imports and no markdown fences.

Respond with ONLY one JSON object, no prose, no fences:
{"verdict": "pass" | "fail", "severity": "minor" | "major", "issues": ["..."]}
- verdict "pass" = every checklist item holds; omit severity and use issues: [].
- verdict "fail" = any item fails; severity "major" if item 1 or 6 fails or the code would not compile, else "minor"; list each failing item in issues.

CODE:
${ARTIFACT}
